themes.theme: Long arrows and connected notes placed far apart (no edge-length penalty)
themes.rule: After placement, measure each uncut arrow's length between facing sides. (1) Order and place stars by arrow weight: place each note next to its most-connected neighbour, and put a hub at the centroid of its users on rings by weight. (2) Add edge length to the packing cost, not only crossings. (3) Cut to a pill any arrow longer than about 3 note widths, or about a third of the board's width. (4) Run a post-pass that moves any note whose longest uncut arrow exceeds the cap next to that arrow's other end when a free slot is there. Aim at straight, short links, and avoid U-shaped arcs that double back.
themes.examples: DetailPanel: DetailTabView to Controls (1200) and DetailPanelPlugin to DetailTakeovers (1114). Validation: IssuesTab to IssueLinePlaces (1620) and IssueList to IssueWalkStyle (1419). Mentions: MentionPicker to Mentionable (1858) and MentionDrawing to MentionTextFormat (1673). Queries: QueryState to Hints (1477). Also TypesForm (DefinitionAccessibility to CardAccessibility, 1119) and CanvasPlugins (core to MadeBeside, 2400+).

themes.theme: Pill strips fan, hatch and crowd: too many per note, on the arrow side, or converging on one point
themes.rule: For each note, cap pills per strip at 5-8 and cap total pills near the note (about 12-24). Spill the rest to the other free sides, then to a second ring, or collect them into a shared hub note or pill list. Never put a strip on the side where the note's own uncut arrows leave, or on the side facing a neighbouring note: choose sides by the free-side angle. Put pills level with their attachment points so lines run straight and parallel, not fanned into one point and not arcing around neighbours. Keep a gap of at least one strip width between neighbouring notes' strips, so it is clear whose pills are whose.
themes.examples: Types: TypesPlugin with 62 pills in an 8-wide block that hides the note. StickyNotes: StickyNotes.swift with about 60 pills in a wall. Arrows: ArrowDefinition with 50 pills. CanvasEditor: CanvasEditor.swift with 48 pills in a ring. TypesRows: RowBook with 45 pills. TypesSync: FieldFill with 35 pills in a curved fan.

themes.theme: Plugin system frame placed far from the notes that connect to it, or sparse, oversized or mis-sized
themes.rule: Place the frame on the board edge facing the notes with the most arrows into it, adjacent to them, so its links are short and do not cross the frame or other notes. Size the frame to its contents plus a margin: use a tight star around the dominant plugin (ring radius grows with leaf count and note size) or a compact grid, with no empty band. Keep its members inside it, and give a one-note frame no extra space. Count the frame's links when scoring edge length.
themes.examples: CanvasPlugins: a 40-wide fan inside a frame that takes two thirds of the board. Validation: a wide band along the bottom with IssueRowValues below it, outside. DetailPanel: the frame sits far below DetailPanel and DetailPanelPlugin with a long gray arrow. Mentions: the frame spans the top with a 1000+ line down to a pink note. Also Colors and DecisionCommands (a mostly empty frame).

themes.theme: Loose or low-degree notes parked at corners or in the middle of open space
themes.rule: Detect notes whose uncut arrows number 0 or 1 (a note whose arrows were all cut to pills counts). Move a single-arrow note next to that neighbour. Pack a note with no arrows into a compact leftover row or grid beside the main cluster, or beside the note holding the pill that points at it, never at a corner, the far edge or the middle of open space.
themes.examples: TypesRows: TypePillEditor stranded top-right. CanvasEditor: ReadsAsText in the bottom-left corner. Selection: Labels, Accessibility and Popovers alone at the left. QueryTranslation: StoredBinding floating in the centre. Also CanvasTools (ResizeAdjusting) and JumpTo (JumpToCatalog).

themes.theme: Board too big or sparse, with an aspect far from the window's about 1.5
themes.rule: Compute the board's area against the sum of its notes plus their strips, and its aspect. Pack stars by shelves or tiles, ordered by connectivity, with gaps sized to strip width (about one strip plus a margin, not a fixed large spacing), and compress any empty gap wider than a note after strips are placed. Target an aspect of 1.5 (reject above about 2 or below about 0.8): wrap long rows and chains into a grid or columns. A cap on area per note (area at most about 1.0x today's) catches the sprawl before it ships.
themes.examples: Publishing: 3339x1061, aspect 3.15. FuzzyMatching: aspect 5.3 from five notes in one row. References: 5643x2841 at 1.19x today. CanvasPlugins: 6653x4348. Mentions: 6041x5690 at 1.63x. Draw: 2.2x today's area. ContextMenus and Topology: tall chains at aspect 0.77 and 0.76.

themes.theme: Disconnected clusters or islands with big gaps between them
themes.rule: Treat connected components or loosely linked clusters as rectangles and pack them tightly, with the larger ones first and smaller ones in the gaps beside them. Keep the gap between clusters to about one note width or one strip width. Where a few thin lines join the clusters, move the cluster ends together, or cut those lines to pills.
themes.examples: CanvasUI: three islands (Minimap/Card/Zoom, ShapeElements/CanvasView, the window cluster) in 3575x2554. Draw: three loose clusters in 2.2x the area. Connections: the Port family spread over the board at 1.7x. Grouping: three disconnected places.

themes.theme: Staggered or ragged note alignment, and links entering off-centre
themes.rule: Snap notes into rows or columns by connectivity, with linked notes sharing a row or column when they can. Attach each link at the facing sides' midpoints, with the note-gap uniform. Avoid long single-column chains by folding them into a row. Lay notes that have no edges between them in an even balanced grid, with the connected note inside it, not off to one side.
themes.examples: DrawScript: staggered grid with Syntax.swift off-centre among its users. TextEditing: EditingTextView to TextEditingStyle entering at off-centre stubs. Canvas: nine unconnected notes in rows of 2, 4 and 2. Publishing: PublicStyle stacked in a long column.

themes.theme: Hub not at the centre of its users, and a repeated hub not drawn as a note
themes.rule: Place a hub at the centroid of its users, with users in a ring or fan at a bounded distance (about the hub's size). When the same target would be drawn as a pill beside four or more notes, make it a hub note, or a pill strip they share, instead of one pill per user.
themes.examples: Colors: NamedColors sits off to the bottom-right of ColorBook and ColorList. Draw: DrawPoints at the far right, away from its users. CanvasEditor: CanvasEditor.swift low-centre, away from CanvasEditor+Host. CanvasSchema: JSONValue, JSON and Identity pills repeated beside four or five notes.

themes.summary: The stars layout reads well on small, quiet boards (12 judged good; Geometry, CanvasQuickLook, InfiniteCanvas, Chrome and Palette had no issues), but it degrades as boards grow: 17 of the 71 were judged bad and most of the rest ok-with-flaws. The recurring defects are structural, not cosmetic. Placement ignores arrow length, so connected notes land far apart and the frame, loose notes and clusters end up scattered, which also inflates the board's size and skews its aspect. Pill strips are the second fault: hubs carry 30 to 60 pills that fan into one point, sit on the side the note's arrows leave from, and hatch over neighbours. The first fix to try is an edge-length-aware placement with a length cap, followed by caps on pills per strip and per note, side selection that avoids the arrow side, and packing for aspect.

issues.what: Five unconnected notes in a single row make a very wide strip (aspect 5.3), poor fit for the window

issues.what: ModelAnswer.swift is a loose note parked far below the rest

issues.what: Many long arrows form a mesh across the board; no clear hub with users around it, and an arc sweeps down the left edge
issues.where: AnthropicSettings.swift to AnthropicModel.swift, AnthropicSettingsView.swift; AnthropicModel.swift to ClaudeCodeModel.swift

issues.what: Plugin system frame is far from most notes, low on the right under the plugin note, leaving a large empty lower half

issues.what: A strip of 7 pills hatches into LanguageModelsPlugin.swift's right edge, which is also where its arrows leave

issues.what: Board is large with big gaps between three clusters, so short arrows still leave a wide spread; the Plugin system frame floats above without arrows to the notes

issues.what: StickyNotes.swift has about 60 pills in rows above and below and columns beside it, a dense wall with lines hatching over its own pills

issues.what: NoteLinks.swift and NoteRow.swift sit apart at the bottom left, with only a few arrows to others

issues.what: Plugin system frame sits at the bottom, far from the notes it connects to, with a very large inside

issues.what: Pill strips of neighbouring notes run into each other, so it is hard to tell whose they are

issues.what: No hubs with users around them: a mesh of 18 notes, each with up to 30 pills; pills crowd together between neighbouring notes

issues.what: Long arrows cross the board between distant notes

issues.what: Notes in the lower part sit apart in a ragged line

issues.where: BoardCrumbs.swift to BoardHeadings.swift; BoardHeadingsPlugin to BoardHeadings.swift

issues.what: Plugin system frame is a big empty rectangle to the right; plugins have long gray lines to far-apart notes, and BoardQueries.swift floats off alone at the far right

issues.what: SkeletonTextBars and SkeletonText are a loose pair parked at the lower left, far from everything

issues.what: Help.swift to Commands.swift is a long arc around the right side, and Help is crowded against Arguments

issues.what: Long gray arcs from ContextMenus.swift sweep under the Plugin system frame to ShapeContextMenus and CanvasContextMenu

issues.what: Big empty area at right and bottom left beside the chain

issues.where: Find.swift and its pills (Order, Registry, ShapeScopes, ... Input, ChangeSet)

issues.what: Notes are spread over a wide board, with FindStyle far from FindIndex

issues.what: JumpToCatalog.swift is parked at the far lower left, linked by a long line (325 and longer) to JumpTo.swift

issues.what: Plugin system frame is at the bottom right, away from Moving.swift, with a pill standing in for it, and a empty gap beside

issues.what: QueryOutput's pills sit on top with lines curling to its top corner, lines running behind pills of QueryCommands

issues.what: Notes are scattered as a ladder across the board; SlashTarget, SlashCommandLine lie far from users

issues.what: TitleCovers and TitleTabStyle pill fans converge on TitleCovers' top, crowding lines

issues.what: Huge (4662x2933, 1.72 of today) and a hairball, with very long arrows (FieldTitling to FieldText 809, fieldValues to FieldValues 726, FileFields to RelationshipIndex 618) crossing the middle

issues.what: Many loose-looking notes (FieldWords, RowList, FieldSummary, TitleSource) in the middle left are scattered, with long lines

issues.what: SchemaReadings.swift and JSONCodeColors.swift are loose notes parked at the bottom left, far from TypeSchema

issues.what: The Plugin system frame is large with a sparse inside (6 or so notes, much empty space) and gray lines escaping it

issues.what: TypeIndex.swift (29 pills) is a dense block at top right with lines hatching through its left strip

issues.what: Very long arrows sweep across the board between top-row hubs and the lower plugin frame, crossing the middle band (ArrowsPlugin to ArrowBindingRules about 1580; ArrowEndLine to ArrowStyle; ArrowParts to Connectables). They fan from a few hubs into a hatch.

issues.what: The Plugin system frame is placed beside Keyboard.swift, but its contents connect by three long gray lines (including a long arc under PressFocused). PressFocused is the longest arrow (652) and runs from the bottom of the board.
issues.rule: Place declared notes in a frame next to the note that declares them, with arrows leaving the facing sides, not wrapping around.

issues.what: The notes are scattered: NeighborState at the top left, Neighbors below it, NeighborStyle alone in the middle top, NeighborDetails, NeighborList at the right. Pills lead to the board's edge, and NeighborStyle appears as a loose note with no pills or arrows, placed in the middle of nothing.
issues.rule: A note with no visible edges sits with the rest in a leftover grid or next to its nearest connected note, not in the middle of other notes.

issues.what: NeighborState and NeighborList have pills in three strips, with lines in tight bundles that hatch over their own pills. NeighborState's lines come down in a fan at the top and an arc at the right leads to Neighbors.
issues.where: NeighborState.swift top fan; NeighborList.swift left column
issues.rule: Keep a note's pill strips off the side where its arrows leave, and limit strips to about 5-6 pills so the lines do not fan.

issues.what: The Plugin system frame sits at the bottom, with long diagonal gray lines (from NeighborDetails and Neighbors) running across the notes' pills down to NeighborDetailsPlugin and NeighborLights.
issues.where: Plugin system frame; lines from Neighbors.swift and NeighborDetails.swift
issues.rule: Place the plugin frame adjacent to the notes that declare into it, on the side facing them, so its lines are short.

issues.what: Eight notes with 21 arrows between them are arranged with several long lines running across the board: an arc from Parser over to QueryError, a long curve from Parser down to Printer, KnownInventions to Printer on a diagonal, and Printer to Lexer along the bottom. Nothing reads as a hub, though Parser, Syntax and Lexer clearly have the most links.
issues.rule: Place notes by a force- or layer-based layout that minimizes total edge length for dense graphs with few pills; do not keep the pill grid's slot positions for notes with direct arrows.

issues.what: Pills are scattered: the QueryError and Syntax pills sit above KnownInventions, the Lexer and QueryLanguage pills right of Parser, and a Parser pill below Printer. They are few and fine, but each sits on a different side with no pattern.
issues.rule: Place a note's few pills on the side facing their target note's direction.

issues.what: Snapping.swift has 17 pills in two fans above it, and lines curve in a bundle into the top of the note, hatching over each other and over the pills' own row (Input, CanvasDocument, ChangeSet). Strips are ragged and staggered at three heights.
issues.rule: Cap a strip at 5-6 pills and spread the rest to the free sides; keep each strip's pills in one straight row so the lines run straight.

issues.what: The board is wide (aspect 1.97) and has large empty areas at the top left and bottom right. The Plugin system frame sits at the far right, joined by one long straight line.
issues.rule: Fit the layout to the window aspect by arranging a hub's pill strips on all four sides, not only above.

issues.what: SnapTargets, SnappingStyle and Snapping are connected by long lines, and SnapTargets is a tall note. Lines from SnapTargets to Snapping cross the area of the Geometry/Camera pills.
issues.rule: Keep a note's pills off the side facing its note neighbours.

issues.what: The board is tall and narrow (aspect 0.76, 2102x2774), and notes are in a long chain down the left (Containment, Preparing, Forwarding, EdgeSources, TopologyIndex), with the Plugin system frame wedged in the middle. The window shows it very small.
issues.where: Whole board; left chain Containment, Preparing, Forwarding, EdgeSources, TopologyIndex
issues.rule: Fit a chain of notes into a wider shape (bend it into columns) to approach the window's aspect of about 1.5.

issues.what: The longest arrow, TopologySnapshot to Containment (1202), runs as a large arc across the top of the board, and a second arc runs from Forwarding to EdgeSources. TopologyPlugin to EdgeTypes is an arc, too.
issues.where: TopologySnapshot.swift to Containment.swift; Forwarding.swift to EdgeSources.swift
issues.rule: Penalize an arrow's length when placing notes so the most-connected neighbours are adjacent; put long arrows between facing sides.

issues.what: Forwarding.swift has a fan of 8 curved pill lines at its top meeting at one point, and TopologyIndex has 12 pills in two columns and a bottom row.
issues.rule: Spread pills over several sides, at most 5-6 per strip, with lines straight.

issues.what: The Plugin system frame has long gray lines running through the notes' pills (EdgeTypes to EdgeForwarding, Forwarding to EdgeSources) and sits in the middle of the board.
issues.rule: Put the plugin frame at the edge of the board on the side facing the notes it connects to.

issues.what: Twenty-nine notes and 341 pills are spread over 4054x4483. The board is too big and busy to read: it is a dense field of small clusters with large empty gaps between them, and the pills outnumber everything else. At the window zoom, it is unreadable.
issues.rule: Pack clusters tightly, and where a note has more than about 20 pills, collect them into a pill list or hub notes; a board's size must follow its note count (a cap on area per note).

issues.what: Very long lines cross the board: DefinitionAccessibility to CardAccessibility (1119), FieldFormJSON to FieldForm (1045), and large arcs at the bottom between DefinitionView, FieldFormAccessibility and FieldSheet. The notes are placed far from their neighbours.
issues.rule: Place notes near the notes they are connected to (minimize total edge length across the board) and reject layouts whose longest edge is more than about a third of the board.

issues.what: Many notes have 30-40 pills in bundles around them (FieldFormView, FieldFormKeys, FieldGridView, FieldSheet, FieldsPanel), and the lines hatch over their own pills and each other. FieldFormKeys and FieldFormAccessibility have a fan of curved lines meeting at one point.
issues.rule: Cap pills per note (about 12-16), and make the rest hubs, reached through one shared pill row; stop fans by placing pills level with their attachment points.

issues.what: The Plugin system frame sits alone at the bottom with one note and one pill, far from everything that it connects to.
issues.rule: Place the plugin frame next to the note it declares into (or at the board's edge, closest to that note).

issues.what: At 3714x4045 the board is tall and sparse. The notes are scattered across the top half with large empty areas, and the Plugin system frame is a wide band along the bottom, with IssueRowValues placed below it, out of the frame.
issues.where: Whole board; Plugin system frame, IssueRowValues
issues.rule: Pack the notes tight and keep a frame's contents inside it; a frame's size must follow its contents, not become a band under the board.

issues.what: Many long arrows cross the board: IssuesTab to IssueLinePlaces (1620), IssueList to IssueWalkStyle (1419), IssueWalk to IssueLights, and long lines from IssueWalkStyle to IssueList. Strongly connected notes (IssueWalk, IssueList, IssueLinePlaces) are far apart.
issues.rule: Place notes with the most arrows between them adjacent; penalize total edge length and reject layouts with arrows over about a quarter of the board's width.

issues.what: IssueWalk, Validation, IssueList, IssueTab and IssueWalkPanel have 12-18 pills in dense fans and bundles above and below. Lines from ValidationQueries to ValidationChecks and from IssueWalk to IssueLinePlaces hatch over pills of other notes.
issues.rule: Cap a strip at 5-6, keep the strips on the sides not used by arrows, and spread to the four sides.

issues.what: The frame has six plugin notes in a row, with only a gray line from ValidationChecksPlugin and ValidationDetailsPlugin to the notes above, which cross the board; several of the plugin notes are not connected to anything.
issues.rule: Put the plugin frame next to the notes that connect to it and arrange its inside as a star around the plugin that declares most of it.
